name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on *all* PRs—open and merged—for two weeks. This lets us compare its feedback against human reviews across the full lifecycle, not just after merges. The trade-off is higher noise in open PRs, but we catch false positives earlier.

name: Gauge
text: Shadow mode risks training reviewers to ignore *all* autofeedback—not just noise. A better alternative: run PR-Agent only on PRs flagged by a lightweight heuristic (e.g., new contributors or high-risk changes). Settle it by measuring reviewer engagement with autofeedback before/after the change.
